concepts.prompt: Use case: logo-brand. Design an original, premium logo concept for OpenPilot, a fast native Windows/Linux dual-pane file manager with tabs, powerful search, previews and modular tools. Concept name: Split Orbit. The symbol is an ingenious compact geometric O formed by two offset, open rectangular pane shapes, with a small directional cut or passage in the negative space suggesting moving fluidly between two panes. Clever, architectural, strong silhouette, balanced corners; distinctive enough to recognize at 24 pixels. Explore a restrained electric cyan / deep cobalt palette with ink navy. Flat vector-like artwork with precise intentional geometry, no gradients or glossy effects. Create a beautiful landscape logo presentation on warm off-white: large principal symbol and 'OpenPilot' wordmark as the main horizontal lockup in the upper central area, ample breathing room. Typeface is a carefully kerned contemporary humanist sans, slightly technical but friendly. Across a smaller lower row, show the SAME symbol as a monochrome mark and as two small app-icon treatments on light and dark rounded-square tiles, demonstrating legibility. Small discreet concept label '01 / SPLIT ORBIT' at top left. Exact wordmark text: 'OpenPilot'. No tagline, no paragraphs, no browser/UI mockup, no unrelated brands, no stock-folder-with-magnifying-glass cliche, no automotive imagery, no decorative background shapes. This is a concept exploration, not a photo of a physical card. The different applications must all preserve exactly the same symbol geometry. Make it feel designed by an excellent independent identity studio.

Use case: logo-brand. Design an original logo concept for OpenPilot, a native Windows/Linux file manager for navigating files, folders and multiple workspaces. Concept name: Waypoint. Develop a bold minimal navigation emblem: an open circular compass/aperture with one confident directional wedge, the cuts subtly implying both an O and a P. An exceptionally clear, proprietary silhouette, optical balance and generous negative space, just a few large geometric elements, legible at 24 pixels. The personality is assured, precise, quietly adventurous. Color direction: vivid chartreuse or fresh lime against charcoal-black, with an off-white ground. Flat crisp vector-like design, no glow, gradients or 3D. Create a beautiful landscape identity presentation: principal symbol beside the exact wordmark 'OpenPilot' in an exceptionally clean, carefully spaced geometric sans. Show this horizontal lockup prominently with ample margins. Across a smaller lower row, show the SAME mark in solid monochrome and two small app-icon applications in light and dark rounded-square tiles. Small restrained label '02 / WAYPOINT' at top left. A warm off-white editorial board with disciplined layout, refined typography and no other copy. No car, road, steering wheel, existing brand mark, generic paper-plane logo, unnecessary thin lines, photograph or product mockup. No slogan. The symbol should have an identity of its own, not a generic compass rose. Preserve the same geometry in all applications.

Use case: logo-brand. Create an original, expressive but highly usable identity for 'OpenPilot', a native Windows/Linux file explorer and modular productivity workbench. Concept name: Folderwing. Invent an elegant abstract folded folder that becomes a soaring small bird or wing: a recognisable folder-tab hint on one edge, two bold folded surfaces, a surprising clever negative-space fold. The personality is curious, fast, independent and friendly. It must be a beautifully simple flat silhouette that still works as an app icon at 24 pixels, not a detailed illustration. Color direction: warm vermilion / soft coral paired with rich plum or midnight ink, on a pale warm cream background. Flat vector-like artwork with immaculate curves and deliberate geometry, maximum two solid colors in the symbol, no gradients or 3D lighting. Landscape identity presentation: a large symbol and exact wordmark 'OpenPilot' as a principal horizontal lockup, bespoke-feeling rounded humanist sans wordmark, carefully kerned and grown-up rather than cartoonish. Small restrained concept label '03 / FOLDERWING' at top left. Across a smaller lower row demonstrate the SAME symbol in monochrome plus two small light/dark rounded-square app-icon treatments. Abundant whitespace, premium independent software brand, strong editorial composition. No explanatory copy, no slogan, no realistic bird, no eyes or mascot face, no stock paper-plane silhouette, no cars or automotive associations, no existing brand logos, no photography. Preserve the exact emblem geometry across applications.
